meta.name: game-scope-check
meta.description: Evaluate project scope against timeline and resources. Triggers on: "scope creep", "feature list", "can we fit this in", "timeline pressure", "resource constraints", "cut list", "scope evaluation". Do NOT invoke for sprint planning (use game-sprint-plan) or general project status (use game-producer). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估项目范围是否匹配时间与资源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常担心项目范围失控或资源不够用
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate project scope against timeline and resources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about scope creep or resource constraints

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成项目范围评估：列出所有功能、按优先级分类、打分、检查时间线是否合理，并生成一份范围评估报告。
howto.when: 当你提到“范围蔓延”、“功能列表”、“我们能塞下这个吗”等关键词，或要求评估项目范围时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下当前的功能列表是否超范围。
say.note: Claude 会启动范围检查流程，引导你列出所有功能。

say.text: 我们还能再加一个功能吗？
say.note: Claude 会触发范围评估，要求你提供功能列表或里程碑。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude guides you through a project scope evaluation: list all features, classify by priority, score them, check timeline feasibility, and produce a Scope Assessment Report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "scope creep", "feature list", "can we fit this in", or ask to evaluate project scope.

say_en.text: Help me check if the current feature list is over scope.
say_en.note: Claude starts the scope check workflow, guiding you to list all features.

say_en.text: Can we add one more feature?
say_en.note: Claude triggers scope evaluation, asking for a feature list or milestone.
